title: A raw file starting with #! is executable (manifest flag), so it carries pg.table and needs final coverage that no observer can meet; the same text without #! is data

assert.why: A.7.5.1 rule 4: coverage with an unmet final pair blocks until two eligible persons answer

A.3.2.4 [D27]: raw:src/audit/purge starts with #! and the manifest flags it executable, making it a raw carrier (A.12.4: pg.table lists raw executables); A.4.5.3 effect(pg.table("audit_events")) applies; the forbid (scope *) covers ungoverned at final, so the pair is needed (A.7.4.2) and no observer reads raw files (§7.4); A.7.4.4 tier max(normal, final); owner of ungoverned is the shape owner (A.3.3.5)
no fact is observed at the script
A.4.5.3: raw data (no #!, not on the script list, mode 100644, executable false) carries no channel
A.7.4.5: code under no applicable channel is covered vacuously
